title: Bigger Numbers, Same Idea
objective: Every idea in this unit (cardinality, subitizing, matching, more/less/equal, counting on) applies just as well to numbers up to about 12, not only to the small numbers first used to introduce them.
studentQuestion: Does this still work with a bigger number?

teaching.see: What do you already know how to find out about a group like this?
teaching.break: The learner chooses their own method — count, subitize a known chunk and count on, or compare to another group.
teaching.transform: The same quantity, described using at least two of the unit's tools — same value, different tools/forms.

check.prompt: A second method confirms the first.

examples.transfer: Comparing two groups of 10-12 using pairing.

mastery.evidence: Independently chooses and executes at least two different valid methods across two examples, and both give the same, correct total.
